summary: Energy Fuels Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Australian Strategic Materials Limited (ASM) via a scheme of arrangement. On August 28, 2026, EFR Critical Materials Pty Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary, acquired all ASM ordinary shares. Each ASM holder received 0.053 Energy Fuels common shares or CHESS Depositary Interests plus A$0.13 cash per share. Total consideration was approximately US$243.4 million, comprising US$217.2 million in stock and US$26.2 million cash. ASM option holders received A$0.50 per option. New shares were issued under Section 3(a)(10) exemption. The deal closed under a Scheme Implementation Deed dated January 21, 2026. What to watch: integration execution and ASM's critical minerals portfolio contribution.
